usage: Use 小提琴 as a countable noun for the instrument "violin" in everyday speech and writing.
It is common after verbs like "拉" when talking about playing the instrument; this is the most natural collocation for learners.
You can use it with measure words and modifiers to describe one violin, a specific violin, or a type of violin.
The word is neutral in register and works in both casual conversation and formal contexts, such as music lessons or performance descriptions.
